lines.zh: 我在平原上小跑，鼻子贴地。
lines.en: I trot the plains with my nose to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩过干草，沙沙响。
lines.en: My paws rustle through the dry grass.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，闻每一块石头。
lines.en: I stop and sniff every stone.

lines.zh: 我尾巴翘着，步子很轻快。
lines.en: Tail up, I keep an easy pace.

lines.zh: 我绕着一个土坑转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle a dirt pit twice.
I lift my head toward the distant sheep.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，耳朵往后贴。
lines.en: I break into a trot, ears pinned back.
The plains are wide; I have far to go.

lines.zh: 我踩到一根骨头，叼起来。
lines.en: I step on a bone and pick it up.
I run ahead, then look back for you.
The wind folds my ears backward.
I follow a fence, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低低地哼。
lines.en: I walk along, humming low in my throat.
I sit and scratch my ear with a hind leg.
I lift my head and howl at a cloud.
Done howling, I lick my nose.

lines.zh: 我趴下，把下巴搁在爪上。
lines.en: I lie down with my chin on my paws.

lines.zh: 有只蝴蝶落在我的尾巴上。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my tail.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶停在我尾巴上，我不动。
lines.en: A butterfly rests on my tail; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打哈欠，露出尖牙。
lines.en: I yawn wide and bare my fangs.
I shake and grass bits fly off.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听，远处有人在干活。
lines.en: I listen; someone is working far off.
I flop over and offer my belly.

lines.zh: 阳光晒得我眼睛眯起来。
lines.en: The sun makes my eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱了拱地上的骨头。
lines.en: I nudge a bone with my nose.

lines.zh: 我忽然站起来，又坐回去。
lines.en: I stand up suddenly, then sit again.

lines.zh: 太安静了，我又想嚎一声。
lines.en: Too quiet; I want to howl again.
I lick my paw and lie down again.
Do you have a bone in that hand?

lines.zh: 我歪头，把你从头闻到脚。
lines.en: I tilt my head and sniff you all over.
There is plain mud on your boots.
I do not bark; I just prick my ears.
You crouch, and I edge sideways.
You smell all right, like a campfire.
My tail wags twice, slowly.
You reach out; I sniff your fingertips.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，等你说话。
lines.en: I hold your gaze, waiting for you to speak.
Do you carry the smell of a cat?
I sit up straight and act well behaved.

lines.zh: 你一动，我耳朵就转过去。
lines.en: When you move, my ears swivel.

lines.zh: 我在想，你会不会留下我。
lines.en: I wonder whether you will keep me.

lines.zh: 你笑一下，我尾巴就停不住。
lines.en: You smile, and my tail will not stop.
You hold still, so do I.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你手里的东西。
lines.en: I sniff what is in your hand.
Are you leaving? I'll come.
I crouch and wait for a pat.
Your voice is low; I like it.
I watch the lane and you both.
You struck me; I will not forget.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我夹起尾巴。
lines.en: The blow makes me tuck my tail.
I back off, but not far.
Blood runs down from my torn ear.
I growl a warning to stay back.
I barely dare put weight on my hind leg.
One of my bones got knocked loose.
I circle you, looking for a chance.
This wound will take long to lick better.
I am not easy prey, truly.

lines.zh: 骨头，骨头，你手里有骨头。
lines.en: Bone, bone, you have a bone.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，口水都出来了。
lines.en: I stare at your hand and drool a little.
Bring it closer; my nose is itching.
I am sitting nicely; see how good I am?
Raise the bone and I will jump.
I circle around your legs.

lines.zh: 这根骨头埋过土，我闻得出。
lines.en: This bone was buried; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你丢出去，我一定捡回来。
lines.en: Throw it and I will surely bring it back.

lines.zh: 我轻轻叼住，不咬你的手。
lines.en: I take it gently and never bite your hand.
One is not enough; I still have appetite.
I push your palm with my nose.
You take a step, and I take one.

lines.zh: 我趴下，把骨头压在爪间。
lines.en: I lie down and pin the bone under my paws.

lines.zh: 这味道像很久前的火堆。
lines.en: This smells like a campfire long ago.

lines.zh: 骨头在你身后，我看见了。
lines.en: The bone is behind you. Seen it.
I sit, tail sweeping the dirt.
Hold your hand flat and I'll come.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我低吼了一声。
lines.en: You bump me and I let out a low growl.
I brace my shoulder and hold my ground.
My tail gets stepped on and I glare back.
You crowd me against a hay bale.
I hop around to your other side.
The knock sets my ears buzzing.
I shake my head; my fur is a mess.
Move aside and I will quiet down.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你鞋上留了印。
lines.en: My claws left marks on your shoe.
After the bump we sniff each other.

lines.zh: 平原上有只狗回了我的嚎。
lines.en: A dog on the plains answers my howl.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此跑了一圈。
lines.en: We run one circle around each other.
It licks my ear.

lines.zh: 我把找到的骨头让给它。
lines.en: I give it the bone I found.
We stretch out together in the grass.

lines.zh: 它打了个喷嚏，我吓了一跳。
lines.en: It sneezes and startles me.
We howl at the moon together.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一直碰着我的。
lines.en: Its tail keeps brushing mine.

lines.zh: 我替它把背上的草叼掉。
lines.en: I pull the grass from its back.

lines.zh: 这个平原，我们分了半边。
lines.en: We split this plain in half.

lines.zh: 我叼起骨头，尾巴摇成一片。
lines.en: I pick up the bone and my tail blurs.

lines.zh: 这东西能吃吗，我先咬咬。
lines.en: Can I eat this? Let me bite it.
I bury it under the tall grass.

lines.zh: 我叼着你的靴子跑远了。
lines.en: I grab your boot and run off.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿太硬，我放下了。
lines.en: This thing is too hard; I drop it.

lines.zh: 我捡了根树枝，想让你扔。
lines.en: I fetch a stick, hoping you will throw it.
I haul it back and drop it by your boots.

lines.zh: 土里埋的东西，我挖出来了。
lines.en: I dug up what was buried in the dirt.
My mouth is full and I cannot bark.
I got to it first; let go.
Something just hit me.

lines.zh: 我转过身，找到了那个影子。
lines.en: I turn and find that shape.
It is still there and has not run.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛一根根立起。
lines.en: The fur on my back rises one by one.

lines.zh: 十六格内有只猫在看我。
lines.en: A cat watches me from sixteen blocks off.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，忘了原来的目标。
lines.en: I stare at it and forget my first target.
That one is holding a stick.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I hug the ground and creep over.
It backs off, so I close the gap.
This cannot end here.
I prowl around it, hunting for a gap.
It raises a hand and I dodge.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里一直有低吼。
lines.en: A growl stays low in my throat.
I feint left but go right.
It backs to the fence with nowhere to go.
I watch only its ankles.
It turns, and I lunge.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土里抓出印。
lines.en: My claws dig marks into the dirt.
Not yet; let it strike first.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，像一张拉满的弓。
lines.en: I arch my back like a drawn bow.
I clamp my teeth on its wrist.
The pain makes it drop the stick.

lines.zh: 我撞它的膝盖，把它推倒。
lines.en: I ram its knee and knock it down.
My claws rake across its leggings.
It kicks; I bite its boot.
One bite, then release, no grappling.
This bite is for that earlier blow.
My teeth hit iron and go numb.

lines.zh: 它爬起来跑了，我追两步。
lines.en: It scrambles up and runs; I chase two steps.
Done, I shake my head and pant.

lines.zh: 我在平原的草垛边醒来。
lines.en: I wake beside a hay bale on the plains.
Windy here, but the grass is soft.

lines.zh: 我先对着天空嚎了一声。
lines.en: First I howl at the open sky.
Some sheep graze in the distance.
I sniff around; no other dogs.
I find a slope that blocks the wind.

lines.zh: 太阳刚出来，草上还有露。
lines.en: The sun is new and dew still clings.

lines.zh: 我踩出一圈自己的脚印。
lines.en: I tramp a ring of my own prints.
This place will do; I will remember it.
Who knows whether someone will come.

lines.zh: 火舔到我的毛，焦味冲鼻。
lines.en: Fire licks my fur; the stink is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，爪子抓空。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, claws catching nothing.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我乱刨。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I paddle wildly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，耳朵聋了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my ears go deaf.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的背，我回头咬。
lines.en: An arrow hits my back; I snap at it.
Purple light makes my legs unsteady.
I am so hungry I lick bare bones.
Lightning strikes by my feet and singes me.
I fall, all four paws clawing air.
